White Whale churning himself into furious speed, almost in an instant as it were, rushing
among the boats with open jaws, and a lashing tail, offered appalling battle on every side,
and heedless of the irons darted at him from every boat, seemed only intent on annihilating
each separate plank of which those boats were made.
But skilfully maneuvered, incessantly wheeling like trained chargers in the field, the boats
for a while eluded him, though at times, but by a plank's breadth.
While all the time, Ahab's unearthly slogan tore every other cry but his to shreds.
